thesis: AFTER-HOURS (17:00 ET) read on Friday 2026-08-21, planning the next trading day Monday 2026-08-24 and over the weekend. Structure first: the multi-month frame is intact and, if anything, a touch firmer than the pre-close. SPY 765.72 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, fast 762.33 over slow 707.54), +1.86% above its 50-day (~751.7) and +8.22% over its 200-day (~707.6), mom126/252 +11.07%/+20.00%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.56, so price is about 1.6% under its highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. The headline story into the close is breadth healing: market-heatmap-lab reads 56.52% of 134 (narrow but margin only -3.48, up sharply from the 29.99% on the 8/20 bar), so participation snapped back toward the 60% line on the 8/21 completed bar. Counting persistence by distinct market-bar dates the last three completed bars are 64.33% on 8/19, 29.99% on 8/20 and 56.52% on 8/21, so only one of the three cleared 60% and the latest sits just below the line; three-bar persistence above 60% is still not established. The honest counterweight WIDENED on the gamma axis even as volatility eased: options-structure-lab / gamma-trading-lab (spot 765.57) read SPY still in negative dealer gamma, but signed net GEX DEEPENED to -2.84B (from the pre-close -0.32B) and the flip pushed UP to 769.59, so spot now sits about 4 points BELOW the flip and dealers pin the tape into a tight 765/766 shelf (put wall 765, call wall 766) inside a wider negative pocket that only flips positive above ~769.59, through the 52-week-high area. Yet the front expected move eased again to ±2.67 with atmIV 9.44% (from ±3.18 / 11.21%), in line with a VIX that eased to a calm 15.13, and volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (conditional vol 11.9395%, throttle x1.26). intraday-tape-lab still reads today's session a Reversal risk auction under Algo-controlled control (VWAP 765.81, gap +0.45%, 79 bars). The near-term leaders are mixed: QQQ 713.44 is back exactly at its 50-day (~713.4, ma50Dist 0, mom5 -2.41) while SPMO 148.73 is -1.42% below its 50-day (~150.9) and holds +13.44% over its 200-day (~131.1). Flow stays constructive by premium: options-flow-feed-lab reads call-heavy/leaning-bullish (callFraction 0.7091, call premium $2.607B against put premium $1.070B across 12 tickers, 1798 contracts over the $250k bar) with the most-unusual print an AMD 470 CALL ($7.1M on 9.2x open interest, 0DTE), though a SPY 766 PUT and an NVDA 215 PUT sit next, a hint of index-level downside hedging at the shelf. Leadership tilts toward energy and defensives (XLE at its 52-week high with the highest sector rsMom 102.23, XLV and XLB Leading, XLU/XLP/XLRE/XLC Improving, XLF weakening, XLK Lagging), the global tape is Asia-led (EWS Singapore 86.2 vs ACWI) and real-asset leadership is crypto-led (ETH-USD 73.8, BTC 71.8, GLD softer at 47.6). Structure first, tactical noise last: HOLD the intact structural SPY/SPMO core and the first beta-add tranche while breadth still sits under 60% for persistence, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare and Improving defensives funded from weakening financials, HOLD (not chase) MSFT, and carry only a SMALL weekend tail while dealers stay deeply negative gamma with SPY well under the 769.59 flip and the intraday character reads reversal-risk into a Friday close.
